title: (viewer comment)
problem: A capacitor was shown connected the wrong way round in a circuit.
lesson: Always state and show component orientation correctly: electrolytic capacitor + side to the higher voltage, diode arrow in the direction of conventional current, battery + and - correct. Never draw a connection the script does not describe.

title: (viewer comment)
problem: A 'How to install Kali Linux' video had no actual install steps.
lesson: When the title promises 'how to' / install / setup, the video must show every step in order with the exact commands and a final check - never only background or theory.
